activities.name: Surf Lesson at Batu Bolong
activities.description: Canggu's most accessible surf break — a consistent left and right hander over black volcanic sand. Local instructors run 2-hour group sessions at low tide, foam boards included. Most beginners stand by the end of the session.

activities.name: Sunset at Old Man's
activities.description: Canggu's original surf bar and beach club, open since the early 2000s. The best position in the village to watch the sun drop into the Indian Ocean — claim a table by 5pm. Full bar, wood-fired pizza, and the mellowest wave in Bali right in front of you.

activities.name: Deus Ex Machina
activities.description: Cult motorcycle-surf brand compound: a café, barber, boutique surf shop, and custom bike workshop all within a single rice-field compound. A pilgrimage site for surf and moto culture worldwide. The cappuccino is serious; so is the T-shirt selection.

activities.name: Atlas Beach Club
activities.description: Claimed to be the world's largest beach club: 10,000 square metres, six pools, and international DJ residencies through the season. Berawa beach, northern Canggu. Book a day bed online to guarantee access on weekends.

activities.name: La Brisa
activities.description: A bohemian beach club built from 500 recycled Javanese fishing boats. Signature cocktails, raw fish ceviches, and Sunday live jazz under the open-air canopy at Echo Beach. Arrive before sunset for the best light on the ocean.

activities.name: The Lawn
activities.description: Beachfront lawn bar with the most unobstructed sunset sightline in Canggu — a wide grass terrace descending to the sand. Regular live music on Friday evenings and a buzzing happy hour from 4pm. Reservations not required.

activities.name: Finns Beach Club
activities.description: Bali's most comprehensive recreation club at Berawa Beach — 4 pools including a 50m lap pool, gym, squash, tennis, bowling, and a dedicated beach club terrace. Day passes available; full membership for long stays.

activities.name: Desa Seni Yoga Village
activities.description: Boutique eco-resort and yoga village built around a collection of antique Javanese houses set in a tropical garden. Daily sunrise and evening classes, meditation sessions, and a raw-food café. Drop-in classes welcome.

activities.name: Love Anchor Market
activities.description: Open-air market and boutique strip along Jalan Pantai Batu Bolong. Vintage clothing, local designer labels, hand-dyed batik, surf apparel, and jewellery. No fixed hours — best browsed between 10am and 6pm. Haggling expected.

activities.name: Sunrise Rice Field Bicycle Tour
activities.description: Morning bicycle tour through working rice terraces and traditional banjar villages departing at 6:30am. Narrow concrete paths between paddy fields, stop at a local compound for Balinese breakfast. All abilities welcome. 3-hour return.

activities.name: Tanah Lot Sea Temple
activities.description: Bali's most photographed sea temple perched on a black rock offshore — 20km south of Canggu, accessible on foot at low tide. The sunset is spectacular. Arrive 45 minutes before sunset to secure a clear viewpoint.

activities.name: COMO Uma Canggu
activities.description: Design-forward luxury hotel with an ocean-facing pool directly above Canggu's surf break. Minimalist Balinese architecture, the COMO Shambhala spa programme, and the best beach access in the village. Breakfast included.

activities.name: The Shady Shack
activities.description: Canggu's favourite plant-based restaurant — an open-air garden setting with colourful smoothie bowls, jackfruit rice plates, and daily specials. Queue outside at brunch; takeaway options available. No reservations.

activities.name: Samadi Organic Market
activities.description: Sunday morning organic market in the Samadi Bali compound: local farmers, kombucha vendors, raw-food stalls, and live acoustic music. Opens at 8am, winds down by noon. Free entry. A real neighbourhood institution.

activities.name: Radiantly Alive Yoga
activities.description: Respected yoga school offering drop-in classes, teacher training, and bodywork therapies. A focus on anatomically intelligent practice — strong Iyengar and Anusara influence. Drop-in classes from Rp130,000.
